item.title: Court House Inn, Circa 1881 in Texas. $199,000
item.description: This house has a lot of original details! The house was built in 1881. It is located on .38 acre in Clarksville, Texas. The house features a large wrap around front porch, wood floors, transom windows, wide baseboards, wainscoting, crown moulding, tall ceilings, claw foot tub and a spacious kitchen. item.title: Beautiful floors! C. 1910. One acre in North Carolina. $249,000
item.description: This house has some really beautiful floors! Seems like a very decent price. The house was built in 1910. It is located on 1.01 acres in Windsor, North Carolina. The house features a covered front porch, beautiful wood floors, bead board wainscoting, baseboards, french doors, crown moulding, built-in bookshelves and a lot of natural light. There is an old general store on the property that is currently used for storage. Three bedrooms, two bathrooms and 2,052 square feet. $249,000 Contact Nancy

item.title: Diamond in the Rough! Five acres in Virginia. $274,900
item.description: This house looks like a diamond in the rough to me! It has a pretty setting and decent acreage. The house was built in 1924. It is located on five acres in Ruther Glen, Virginia. The house features a covered front porch, wood floors, baseboards and a country kitchen. There is a large detached building on the property. I think I am seeing some kind of pond behind the house. Two bedrooms, two bathrooms and 1,456 square feet. $274,900 Contact Chelsea Ferguson with 1st Class Real Estate Group: 804-5

item.description: This house has a pretty setting! The interior needs some work, but it has potential! The house was built in 1049. It is located on 9.50 acres in Moretown, Vermont. The house features a covered front porch, large stone hearth, vaulted ceiling, exposed beams, knotty pine and a great antique kitchen stove. item.title: 50 acres in West Virginia! Pretty setting! $320,000
item.description: There is some nice acreage with this house! Pretty setting! The house was built in 1900. It is located on 50 acres in Glenville, West Virginia. The house features double front porches, spacious kitchen, wood floors and baseboards. There are a few outbuildings on the property and lovely garden areas. Four bedrooms and two bathrooms. $320,000 Contact Isaiah Sattelmaier with Central West Virginia Real Estate: 681-533-5119 From the Zillow listing: Introducing 1202 Third Run Road, in Glenville, West

item.title: Diamond in the Rough! C. 1884. Over three acres in North Carolina. $345,000
item.description: This house looks like a diamond in the rough to me! It has nice potential and a pretty setting! This house would really benefit from a floor plan being included with the listing. The house was built in 1884. It is located on 3.11 acres in Fairview, North Carolina. The house features a wrap around front porch, a large stone chimney, wide baseboards, crown moulding, wainscoting and bead board. There is a detached garage on the property. Five bedrooms, two bathrooms and 2,425 square feet. $345,000

item.title: Loads of potential! Great town! Over one acre in Virginia. $145,000
item.description: This is a great little town! The house has loads of potential and looks livable. The house was built in 1880. It is located on 1.33 acres in Chatham, Virginia. The house features a covered front porch, original wood floors, wide baseboards, bay windows and a claw foot tub. That kitchen could definitely use some work. item.title: 5,000 sf! Former rectory. Beautiful woodwork! C. 1880 in Wisconsin. $225,000
item.description: This is a huge house with almost 5,000 square feet! This was the former St. Paul’s Cathedral Rectory. It was built in 1880. It is located on .56 acre in Fond Du Lac, Wisconsin. The house features a limestone exterior, pretty staircase, baseboards, crown moulding, coffered ceiling, french doors, beautiful fireplaces, and some wood floors. I bet all of the wood floors are still underneath the carpeting. Six bedrooms, six bathrooms and 4,951 square feet. $225,000 Contact Teresa Keenan with Klapperi

item.description: Fixer upper alert! There are original details inside. The property has outbuildings. The house was built in 1890. It is located on 1.48 acres in Dothan, Alabama. item.title: Virginia’s most expensive old house listing! Liberty Corner Farm, C. 1790. $18,500,000
item.description: Welcome to Virginia’s most expensive old house listing! Liberty Corner Farm was built in 1790. It is located on 1,888 acres in Esmont, Virginia. The property includes the 1790 main house, three guest houses, pool, pool house and a lodge. There are three lakes on the property.
